title: Effect-Level Validation for Causal Discovery in Interactive Telemetry
abstract: arXiv:2602.08340v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Causal discovery is increasingly used to analyze telemetry from interactive systems, but a plausible graph does not guarantee an identifiable or reliable product decision. We study this problem for one query: whether early competitive gameplay increases Day-1 retention in a deployed Role-playing game (RPG). We propose an admissibility-first framework that treats discovered graphs as structural hypotheses, keeps only graphs that identify the target effect and have adequate treatment-control overlap, and validates admissible effects through cross-algorithm stability, placebo, subsampling, and E-value diagnostics. On real telemetry, under minimal constraints the admissible runs that return Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) are those whose graphs leave player-versus-player (PvP) with no parents, so they estimate the confounded raw difference; under the full constraint set all are admissible. translated_title: 交互式遥测数据中因果发现的效应级验证
translated_abstract: 因果发现方法正越来越多地被用于分析交互式系统的遥测数据，但一个看似合理的图结构并不能保证产生可识别或可靠的产品决策。我们针对一个具体查询研究这一问题：在一款已上线的角色扮演游戏（RPG）中，早期竞技对战是否会提升首日留存率。我们提出一个“可采性优先”框架，将因果发现得到的图视为结构性假设，仅保留能够识别目标效应且处理组与对照组重叠充分的图，并通过跨算法稳定性、安慰剂检验、子采样和E值等诊断手段验证可采效应的可靠性。在真实遥测数据上，在最小约束条件下，返回有向无环图（DAG）的可采运行是那些图中玩家对战（PvP）变量没有父节点的运行，因此它们估计的是受混杂影响的原始差异；而在完整约束条件下，所有运行均满足可采性。返回部分祖先图（PAG）的运行……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“可采性优先”框架，将因果发现的图视为结构性假设，仅保留能识别目标效应且处理-对照重叠充分的图，并通过稳定性、安慰剂、子采样和E值诊断验证效应，用以可靠回答RPG游戏中早期竞技对战是否提升首日留存这一产品问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an admissibility-first framework that treats discovered causal graphs as structural hypotheses, retains only those identifying the target effect with adequate treatment-control overlap, and validates effects via cross-algorithm stability, placebo, subsampling, and E-value diagnostics, applied to whether early competitive gameplay increases Day-1 retention in an RPG.
